name: @hwfee/dsh-usage-stats
description: DeepSeek Harness 的用量统计插件：在新对话页的标题下方显示一张「用量」面板，包含会话数、消息数、总 token、活跃天数、高峰时段、常用模型、活跃度热力图，以及一句按中文字数折算的趣味对比。数据从 ~/.dsh/sessions 的会话日志聚合而来。 / Usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: a stats card on the blank-session hero with sessions, messages, total tokens, active days, peak hour, favourite model, an activity heatmap and a Chinese-literature token comparison, aggregated from the session logs under ~/.dsh/sessions.
author: HwFee <1744567281@qq.com>
